definitions.top1: First ranked class correct / total; raw correct and total retained
definitions.top3: True class among first three ranked classes / total
definitions.tie_order: Descending softmax score; ascending class ID for exact ties
definitions.precision: TP / (TP + FP); zero when no predictions for class
definitions.recall: TP / (TP + FN); zero when no true examples
definitions.f1: 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall); zero for zero denominator
definitions.macro: Unweighted mean over all eight classes
definitions.weighted: Mean weighted by true class support
definitions.roc_auc: One-vs-rest softmax ranking; tied scores grouped; trapezoidal empirical ROC area
definitions.undefined_auc: null if no positives or no negatives; full macro AUC then null
definitions.confusion_matrix: Rows=true class, columns=predicted class, integer counts
definitions.scores: Softmax over eight supported dishes; not calibrated confidence
definitions.subgroups: Descriptive top-1 correct/total by source, dataset, dish, size, transformation and source x dish

error_reviews.visible_context: A plate-filling reddish-brown meat curry has visible meat pieces, green chilies, coriander and thin pale garnish. The plate edge is partly outside the provider frame, but the curry is visible. This square export is resized to 224x224 without an additional geometric crop.
error_reviews.category: Plausible visual confusion between garnished meat curries; label uncertain from pixels alone
error_reviews.report_summary: The reddish-brown meat curry, green chilies and coriander plausibly share visual cues with chicken karahi. The curry is visible despite the provider's partly cut plate edge; the square-to-square model resize adds no geometric crop. Recipe and meat type cannot be established from pixels alone. This explanation is a hypothesis; the nihari label remains unchanged. The app must offer correction before choosing the nutrition entry.
error_reviews.assessment: The meat, gravy and green garnish could supply features shared with chicken karahi. This is a visual hypothesis, not proof of which features caused the prediction. The photograph alone does not establish recipe or meat type, so the source nihari label remains unchanged pending independent human review. No specific source watermark or new crop failure was identified.
error_reviews.app_consequence: The app would select the chicken karahi nutrition entry unless the user corrects it. Nihari is the second suggestion, so presenting alternatives and requiring dish confirmation supports correction.

error_reviews.visible_context: A broad, flat, roughly circular brown serving sits on a shiny metal plate with fried-onion-like strands, nut-like pieces, a lime wedge and a pale round garnish. Most of the plate is visible. This square export is resized to 224x224 without an additional geometric crop.
error_reviews.category: Plausible shape, color and serving-context confusion
error_reviews.report_summary: The broad, flat, roughly circular brown serving on a metal plate could resemble flatbread features. Its textured contents, onion-like strands, nut-like pieces and lime also fit a plated stew. Shape or background are possible cues, not proven causes. The serving is visible and no new crop failure was identified. Keep the source label and let users confirm haleem rather than apply chapati nutrition. Full observations are retained in error_review.json.
error_reviews.assessment: The flat circular brown region could resemble flatbread features, although the visible textured serving and garnishes are compatible with a plated stew. The source label is retained. Shape and metallic background are possible cues, not demonstrated causes; the single example cannot show a systematic background bias. No obvious new crop failure or source watermark was identified.
error_reviews.app_consequence: The app would select a chapati nutrition entry rather than haleem unless corrected, affecting the nutrition estimate. Haleem ranks second, so the confirmation screen should offer the ranked alternatives and a direct correction.
error_reviews.attribution: Rafias Workspace / combined-dataset / uploader-stated CC BY 4.0
